          About this item

          • AMD Athlon Silver 7120U dual-core processor with up to 3.5GHz max boost clock and 2MB L3 cache delivers reliable performance for Microsoft Office applications, web browsing, document editing, and everyday multitasking. 4GB LPDDR5-5500 MT/s RAM ensures smooth performance for essential productivity tasks and online learning. 128GB PCIe NVMe M.2 SSD provides fast boot times and quick application loading with automatic cloud backup via OneDrive.
          • 14-inch HD display (1366 x 768) with micro-edge bezels provides comfortable viewing for work and entertainment. AMD Radeon 610M Graphics handles video playback efficiently. Perfect for students, home users, and budget-conscious buyers. HP True Vision 1080p FHD camera with temporal noise reduction and integrated dual array digital microphones ensures crystal-clear video calls for online learning, virtual meetings, and staying connected with family. Dual speakers deliver quality sound for video conferencing and entertainment.
          • Latest Realtek WiFi 6 (2x2) and Bluetooth 5.4 wireless technology provide fast, reliable internet connectivity and seamless device pairing with Modern Standby (Connected) support. Versatile port selection: 1x USB Type-C 5Gbps (data transfer only), 2x USB Type-A 5Gbps, 1x AC smart pin, 1x HDMI 1.4b for external displays, headphone/mic combo jack.
          • Full-size soft gray keyboard with HP Imagepad touchpad for comfortable typing and navigation. Stylish moonlight blue cover with natural silver base and keyboard frame creates a modern, elegant aesthetic. Ultra-slim design measures 12.74" W x 8.46" D x 0.70-1.28" H and weighs only 3.09 lbs for easy portability. Perfect for students, home users, and budget-conscious buyers.
          • Windows 11 Home in S Mode offers streamlined performance, enhanced security, and Microsoft Store apps for safe computing. Perfect for students, remote workers, and home users seeking affordable productivity with premium features. Includes 1-year Microsoft 365 Personal subscription with full versions of Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, OneNote, Publisher, and Access for creating documents, spreadsheets, presentations, and managing email.

          Product Description

          HP Laptop 14 with Microsoft 365 Personal – Complete Productivity Solution in Moonlight Blue

          What's Included:

          • HP Laptop 14 with AMD Athlon Silver 7120U processor
          • 1-Year Microsoft 365 Personal Subscription
          • 45W Smart AC power adapter

          Microsoft 365 Personal Benefits:

          • Full versions of Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, OneNote, Publisher, and Access
          • 1TB OneDrive cloud storage for secure file backup, sharing, and collaboration
          • Premium Microsoft support and regular feature updates
          • Works across Windows PC, Mac, iPad, iPhone, and Android devices
          • Smart assistance features for better writing, clearer data, and powerful presentations
          • Perfect for students, professionals, remote workers, and home users

          Technical Specifications:

          • Processor: AMD Athlon Silver 7120U (Dual-Core, up to 3.5GHz max boost clock, 2MB L3 cache)
          • Chipset: AMD integrated SoC
          • Memory: 4GB LPDDR5-5500 MT/s
          • Storage: 128GB PCIe NVMe M.2 SSD
          • Graphics: AMD Radeon 610M Graphics
          • Display: 14-inch HD (1366 x 768)
          • Operating System: Windows 11 Home in S Mode
          • Wireless: Realtek WiFi 6 (2x2) + Bluetooth 5.4 with Modern Standby
          • Camera: HP True Vision 1080p FHD with temporal noise reduction and dual array digital microphones
          • Audio: Dual speakers
          • Ports: 1x USB Type-C 5Gbps (data transfer only), 2x USB Type-A 5Gbps, 1x AC smart pin, 1x HDMI 1.4b, 1x headphone/mic combo
          • Security: Mic mute key, camera privacy shutter, Trusted Platform Module (Firmware TPM)
          • Keyboard: Full-size soft gray keyboard
          • Pointing Device: HP Imagepad
          • Dimensions: 12.74 x 8.46 x 0.70-1.28 inches (W x D x H)
          • Weight: 3.09 lbs
          • Power: 45W Smart AC power adapter
          • Color: Moonlight blue cover, natural silver base and keyboard frame
          • Design: Matte paint finish cover and keyboard frame, textured base

          Target Audience:

          • Students needing Microsoft Office for essays, research papers, and presentations
          • Remote workers requiring productivity software and video conferencing
          • Home users managing budgets, organizing files, and staying connected
          • Budget-conscious buyers seeking complete productivity solution with cloud storage
          • Anyone needing reliable Microsoft Office applications with 1TB cloud backup

          Bring your ideas to life with Microsoft 365. Office applications now include smart assistance features that help make your writing more readable, your data clearer, and your presentations more visually powerful.
